Context7 MCP Server -- Up-to-date code documentation for LLMs and AI code editors

repo_meta_data.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool that provides up-to-date documentation for npm packages directly in your IDE. This tool fetches the latest README documentation from either the package's GitHub repository or the README bundled with the npm package itself.
